The example blocker line inside the code fence uses an em-dash (—). recovery-runbook.md is a human-readable persisted doc that previously had zero em-dashes; the project convention prefers no em-dash in persisted human .md. It mirrors the agent template's literal output (where em-dash is allowed), so it is defensible, but a colon or hyphen would keep the runbook em-dash-free. Non-blocking.
